I've been farming these 5 mu for 40 years now, so I know this land. Quzhou soil is alright but salty in some patches — cotton handles it better than most crops. My plan this year is same as last year with small changes, because last season worked out fine.

I'll put 3 mu in cotton — that's my main crop and the price was decent last autumn. The other 2 mu I'll do winter wheat, then summer maize after wheat harvest in June. Two harvests off that plot. My son sends some money from the city, so I have a bit more to spend on fertilizer than tight years.

For cotton: I'll buy the Bt hybrid seed from the dealer in town — everyone plants that now because bollworm used to eat us alive. Before planting I spread compound fertilizer 复合肥 (15-15-15), about 50 jin per mu, that gives roughly 12 kg N, 12 kg P, 12 kg K. Then at flowering I top-dress urea, maybe 30 jin per mu, that's another 7 kg N. So total N around 18-19 kg. I'll irrigate from the well 3 times — once after planting if no rain, once at flowering, once at boll-filling. Cotton needs spraying a lot: aphids early, then spider mites, bollworm check, maybe 6 sprays total. Expect about 250 kg seed cotton per mu, that's what I got last year.

For wheat: plant 石麦 improved variety in October. Basal compound fertilizer 40 jin + urea top-dress at jointing 20 jin. About 14 kg N, 6 kg P, 6 kg K. Water 3 times — winter water, green-up, heading. One spray for aphids and powdery mildew. 450 kg/mu is what my neighbors get.

For maize after wheat: 郑单958 hybrid, no plough — just rotary-till the stubble and plant. Compound fertilizer at planting, urea at big trumpet stage. About 16 kg N total. Water twice if dry. Two sprays. 550 kg/mu.
